title: Eagle Mfg 30-Gallon HDPE Open-Head Poly Drum with Lever Lock Ring - Black
description: The EAGLE MFG 1601BLK is a 30-gallon open head poly drum for containment and material handling applications. It is made of high-density polyethylene and includes a regular lid with a plastic lever-lock closure. The drum is black and measures 28.5 inches in outside height and 21.125 inches in outside length.
